rationale.complete: Round 1 done: synthetic validation on 4 real schedules (S1-S5, call-start jitter propagated), 33 replication periods, 4 native tests (G51, NE41, G18, NE14), two post hoc artifact checks, card and scorecard, confirm.py frozen and dry-run. Holdout not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Clean, well-identified result in regimes II-III (eta ~ 0 in 11/11 periods, G51 units 9/9, exogenous pause-timer dose, s ~ 0 with family controls), with synthetic recovery passing every criterion. But the pre-registered pooled P1 failed because regime I (22 periods) sits between the clocks, two natives failed (G18, NE14), collapse failed, no holdout. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A quantitative operator statement: in computer-use agent loops per-hour coupling = per-call coupling (family trait) x call rate; doubling call rate raises 5-min coupling by ~50% (G51 32%) with CIs; slow agents are heavy spins (8x less wall-time coupling). Cadence (pause timers, tool-call length) is a prompt-free knob. Mostly observational plus one quasi-intervention; regime-specific; the clean intervention (NE20) is untested.

one_line: In the computer-use scaffold agents couple per model call, not per minute; per-hour coupling is a family trait times call rate. Regime I breaks this.
